scope: Register, protocol and allocation references for a733_pcie_function.c and a733_pcie_nvme.c. Linux and U-Boot do not run on the A733 FreeRTOS root; the adapted logic is rewritten for polled native ownership.

bsp/drivers/pci/controller/allwinner/pci.use: SII INTx mask/status and DesignWare MSI target, enable and status handling
INTx demultiplexing on the sii interrupt and LTSSM disable before teardown

sun60iw2p1.dtsi.use: INTIDs 184 (sii) and 185 (msi), the 0x22000000 32-bit memory range and the INTA..INTD map; x1 max-link-speed 3; combo1 PCIe child has no external-reference override

drivers/nvme/host/pci.c.use: Reference only: vector-zero admin IRQ, I/O CQ IEN/IV, phase observation followed by dma_rmb and CQ head doorbell. Linux does not execute on the native image.

bsp/drivers/phy/sunxi-cadence-combophy.c.execution: host reference only; adapted PCIe sequence runs on the FreeRTOS CPU
bsp/drivers/phy/sunxi-cadence-combophy.c.use: combo1 PCIe init selects 100 MHz SERDES then the internal-100-MHz table without an oscillator-rate branch; native PHY table comparison

bsp/drivers/clk/sunxi-ng/ccu-sun60iw2.c.execution: host reference only; adapted PCIe sequence runs on the FreeRTOS CPU
bsp/drivers/clk/sunxi-ng/ccu-sun60iw2.c.use: PLL_REF normalization, SERDES100 from PERI0-600M, PCIe AUX SYS24M and AXI PERI0-400M parents

bsp/drivers/clk/sunxi-ng/ccu-sun60iw2-rt.execution: host reference only; adapted PCIe sequence runs on the FreeRTOS CPU
bsp/drivers/clk/sunxi-ng/ccu-sun60iw2-rt.use: raw DCXO selector includes 26 MHz and DCXO_SERDES1 gate definition

drivers/pci/pci_auto.c.use: BAR sizing with decode off and 64-bit BARs placed below 4 GiB

drivers/nvme/nvme.c.use: Two-entry admin and I/O queues, phase-tagged polled completion, identify, queue creation and read commands

drivers/nvme/nvme.h.use: Controller register layout, CAP fields, CC and CSTS bits and opcodes
